name: How do I measure for a new window apron?

mainEntity.name: How do I measure for a new window apron?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure for a new window apron, first measure the width of your window casing, including the side trim pieces. The apron should typically extend past the side casings by about 1/2 to 1 inch on each side, or match the width of the window stool if one is present. Accurately measuring the existing trim or window opening is a crucial step that helps ensure the new apron will align correctly with your window's existing architectural lines. Precise measurements prevent gaps and create a seamless look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the width of your window casing, including side trim. The apron usually extends slightly beyond the casing or matches the window stool width for a proper fit.
